books.title: The Three Little Pigs
books.source: FIEZEL retelling of a traditional English folk tale (public domain).

about.en: Three pigs build three houses. Only one house is strong enough.
about.id: Tiga babi membangun tiga rumah. Hanya satu rumah yang cukup kuat.

sentences.en: Once upon a time, there were three little pigs.
sentences.id: Pada suatu waktu, ada tiga babi kecil.

sentences.en: They left home to build their own houses.
sentences.id: Mereka meninggalkan rumah untuk membangun rumah sendiri.

sentences.en: The first pig was in a hurry.
sentences.id: Babi pertama sedang terburu-buru.

sentences.en: He built his house with straw.
sentences.id: Dia membangun rumahnya dengan jerami.

sentences.en: It took him only one hour.
sentences.id: Dia hanya butuh satu jam.

sentences.en: The second pig built his house with sticks.
sentences.id: Babi kedua membangun rumahnya dengan ranting.

sentences.en: It took him one day.
sentences.id: Dia butuh satu hari.

sentences.en: The third pig was slow and careful.
sentences.id: Babi ketiga lambat dan berhati-hati.

sentences.en: He built his house with bricks.
sentences.id: Dia membangun rumahnya dengan batu bata.

sentences.en: It took him many weeks.
sentences.id: Dia butuh berminggu-minggu.

sentences.en: His brothers laughed at him.
sentences.id: Saudara-saudaranya menertawakannya.

sentences.en: "Your work is too slow," they said.
sentences.id: "Kerjamu terlalu lambat," kata mereka.

sentences.en: One evening, a hungry wolf came to the village.
sentences.id: Suatu sore, seekor serigala yang lapar datang ke desa.

sentences.en: He knocked on the straw house.
sentences.id: Dia mengetuk rumah jerami.

sentences.en: "Little pig, little pig, let me come in!"
sentences.id: "Babi kecil, babi kecil, biarkan aku masuk!"

sentences.en: "No, not by the hair on my chin!"
sentences.id: "Tidak, sama sekali tidak!"

sentences.en: So the wolf blew the straw house down.
sentences.id: Maka serigala itu meniup rumah jerami sampai roboh.

sentences.en: The first pig ran to his brother's house.
sentences.id: Babi pertama lari ke rumah saudaranya.

sentences.en: The wolf followed him.
sentences.id: Serigala itu mengikutinya.

sentences.en: He blew the house of sticks down too.
sentences.id: Dia juga meniup rumah ranting sampai roboh.

sentences.en: Both pigs ran to the brick house.
sentences.id: Kedua babi lari ke rumah batu bata.

sentences.en: Their hearts were beating fast.
sentences.id: Jantung mereka berdebar kencang.

sentences.en: The wolf blew and blew at the brick house.
sentences.id: Serigala meniup dan meniup rumah batu bata itu.

sentences.en: The house did not move.
sentences.id: Rumah itu tidak bergerak.

sentences.en: He tried again, but he only became tired.
sentences.id: Dia mencoba lagi, tetapi dia hanya menjadi lelah.

sentences.en: Then he climbed onto the roof.
sentences.id: Lalu dia memanjat ke atap.

sentences.en: He wanted to come down the chimney.
sentences.id: Dia ingin turun lewat cerobong asap.

sentences.en: The third pig put a big pot of water on the fire.
sentences.id: Babi ketiga menaruh panci besar berisi air di atas api.

sentences.en: The wolf fell into the hot water and ran away.
sentences.id: Serigala jatuh ke air panas lalu lari.

sentences.en: He never came back to the village.
sentences.id: Dia tidak pernah kembali ke desa itu.

sentences.en: The three pigs lived together in the strong house.
sentences.id: Ketiga babi tinggal bersama di rumah yang kuat itu.

sentences.en: Good work takes time, but it keeps you safe.
sentences.id: Pekerjaan yang baik butuh waktu, tetapi menjagamu tetap aman.

books.title: The Ugly Duckling
books.source: FIEZEL retelling of Hans Christian Andersen's 1843 tale (public domain).

about.en: A bird grows up believing he is ugly, until he sees what he really is.
about.id: Seekor burung tumbuh dengan percaya dirinya jelek, sampai dia melihat dirinya yang sebenarnya.

sentences.en: On a quiet farm, a mother duck sat on her eggs.
sentences.id: Di sebuah peternakan yang tenang, induk bebek mengerami telurnya.

sentences.en: One egg was bigger than the others.
sentences.id: Satu telur lebih besar daripada yang lain.

sentences.en: The small eggs opened first.
sentences.id: Telur-telur kecil menetas lebih dulu.

sentences.en: Five yellow ducklings came out.
sentences.id: Lima anak bebek kuning keluar.

sentences.en: At last the big egg opened.
sentences.id: Akhirnya telur besar itu menetas.

sentences.en: A grey bird came out, and he was large and clumsy.
sentences.id: Seekor burung abu-abu keluar, dan dia besar serta canggung.

sentences.en: "He is not like us," the other ducks said.
sentences.id: "Dia tidak seperti kita," kata bebek-bebek lain.

sentences.en: They called him the ugly duckling.
sentences.id: Mereka memanggilnya anak bebek yang jelek.

sentences.en: The other animals pushed him away.
sentences.id: Hewan-hewan lain mengusirnya.

sentences.en: Even his brothers and sisters laughed at him.
sentences.id: Bahkan saudara-saudaranya menertawakannya.

sentences.en: One morning he left the farm alone.
sentences.id: Suatu pagi dia meninggalkan peternakan sendirian.

sentences.en: He walked through fields and hid in tall grass.
sentences.id: Dia berjalan melewati ladang dan bersembunyi di rumput tinggi.

sentences.en: Autumn came, and the wind grew cold.
sentences.id: Musim gugur datang, dan anginnya menjadi dingin.

sentences.en: He slept near a frozen lake.
sentences.id: Dia tidur di dekat danau yang membeku.

sentences.en: He was hungry and very lonely.
sentences.id: Dia lapar dan sangat kesepian.

sentences.en: But every morning he stood up and walked again.
sentences.id: Tetapi setiap pagi dia bangkit dan berjalan lagi.

sentences.en: Spring came, and the ice melted.
sentences.id: Musim semi datang, dan esnya mencair.

sentences.en: He saw three beautiful white birds on the water.
sentences.id: Dia melihat tiga burung putih yang indah di atas air.

sentences.en: They were swans, and he was afraid of them.
sentences.id: Mereka adalah angsa, dan dia takut kepada mereka.

sentences.en: "They will laugh at me too," he thought.
sentences.id: "Mereka pasti juga akan menertawakanku," pikirnya.

sentences.en: He looked down at the water.
sentences.id: Dia menunduk melihat air.

sentences.en: In the water he saw a white swan.
sentences.id: Di dalam air dia melihat seekor angsa putih.

sentences.en: The swan in the water was him.
sentences.id: Angsa di dalam air itu adalah dirinya.

sentences.en: He had never been an ugly duckling.
sentences.id: Dia tidak pernah menjadi anak bebek yang jelek.

sentences.en: He had only been young, and in the wrong place.
sentences.id: Dia hanya masih kecil, dan berada di tempat yang salah.

sentences.en: The three swans came near and welcomed him.
sentences.id: Ketiga angsa itu mendekat dan menyambutnya.

books.title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
books.source: FIEZEL retelling of Aesop's fable (public domain).

about.en: A shepherd boy lies for fun, and learns what a lie costs.
about.id: Seorang anak gembala berbohong untuk bersenang-senang, dan belajar harga sebuah kebohongan.

sentences.en: A boy took care of sheep on a hill.
sentences.id: Seorang anak menjaga domba di sebuah bukit.

sentences.en: Every day was the same, and he was bored.
sentences.id: Setiap hari sama saja, dan dia bosan.

sentences.en: One afternoon he had an idea.
sentences.id: Suatu siang dia punya ide.

sentences.en: He ran down to the village and shouted.
sentences.id: Dia berlari ke desa dan berteriak.

sentences.en: "Wolf! A wolf is eating the sheep!"
sentences.id: "Serigala! Ada serigala memakan domba!"

sentences.en: The villagers left their work and ran up the hill.
sentences.id: Warga desa meninggalkan pekerjaan dan berlari ke bukit.

sentences.en: There was no wolf.
sentences.id: Tidak ada serigala.

sentences.en: The boy laughed at them.
sentences.id: Anak itu menertawakan mereka.

sentences.en: Two days later he did the same thing.
sentences.id: Dua hari kemudian dia melakukan hal yang sama.

sentences.en: "Wolf! Help me, please!" he shouted.
sentences.id: "Serigala! Tolong aku!" teriaknya.

sentences.en: The villagers ran up the hill again.
sentences.id: Warga desa berlari ke bukit lagi.

sentences.en: Again there was no wolf.
sentences.id: Lagi-lagi tidak ada serigala.

sentences.en: This time nobody laughed.
sentences.id: Kali ini tidak ada yang tertawa.

sentences.en: "Do not lie to us," an old woman said.
sentences.id: "Jangan berbohong kepada kami," kata seorang perempuan tua.

sentences.en: The boy only smiled and went back to his sheep.
sentences.id: Anak itu hanya tersenyum dan kembali ke dombanya.

sentences.en: One evening a real wolf came out of the forest.
sentences.id: Suatu sore, serigala sungguhan keluar dari hutan.

sentences.en: The sheep ran in every direction.
sentences.id: Domba-domba lari ke segala arah.

sentences.en: The boy shouted as loudly as he could.
sentences.id: Anak itu berteriak sekeras-kerasnya.

sentences.en: "Wolf! Please, this time it is true!"
sentences.id: "Serigala! Kali ini sungguhan!"

sentences.en: The villagers heard him, but nobody came.
sentences.id: Warga desa mendengarnya, tetapi tidak ada yang datang.

sentences.en: "He is lying again," they said.
sentences.id: "Dia berbohong lagi," kata mereka.

sentences.en: The boy lost many sheep that night.
sentences.id: Malam itu anak itu kehilangan banyak domba.

sentences.en: A liar is not believed, even when he tells the truth.
sentences.id: Pembohong tidak dipercaya, bahkan saat dia berkata jujur.

books.title: The Lion and the Mouse
books.source: FIEZEL retelling of Aesop's fable (public domain).

about.en: A small mouse helps a great lion, and size stops meaning much.
about.id: Seekor tikus kecil menolong singa besar, dan ukuran tidak lagi berarti banyak.

sentences.en: A lion was sleeping under a tree.
sentences.id: Seekor singa sedang tidur di bawah pohon.

sentences.en: A little mouse ran across his nose.
sentences.id: Seekor tikus kecil berlari melewati hidungnya.

sentences.en: The lion woke up and caught her.
sentences.id: Singa itu terbangun dan menangkapnya.

sentences.en: "Please let me go," the mouse said.
sentences.id: "Tolong lepaskan aku," kata tikus itu.

sentences.en: "One day I will help you."
sentences.id: "Suatu hari aku akan menolongmu."

sentences.en: The lion laughed for a long time.
sentences.id: Singa itu tertawa lama sekali.

sentences.en: "How can a mouse help a lion?" he said.
sentences.id: "Bagaimana seekor tikus bisa menolong singa?" katanya.

sentences.en: But he opened his paw and let her go.
sentences.id: Tetapi dia membuka cakarnya dan melepaskannya.

sentences.en: A week later, hunters came to the forest.
sentences.id: Seminggu kemudian, pemburu datang ke hutan.

sentences.en: They caught the lion in a strong net.
sentences.id: Mereka menangkap singa itu dengan jaring yang kuat.

sentences.en: He pulled and pulled, but he could not move.
sentences.id: Dia menarik dan menarik, tetapi tidak bisa bergerak.

sentences.en: His roar filled the whole forest.
sentences.id: Aumannya memenuhi seluruh hutan.

sentences.en: The little mouse heard him and came running.
sentences.id: Tikus kecil itu mendengarnya dan datang berlari.

sentences.en: She began to cut the ropes with her teeth.
sentences.id: Dia mulai memotong tali dengan giginya.

sentences.en: She worked all night without stopping.
sentences.id: Dia bekerja sepanjang malam tanpa berhenti.

sentences.en: In the morning the lion was free.
sentences.id: Pagi harinya singa itu bebas.

sentences.en: "You were right," he said quietly.
sentences.id: "Kamu benar," katanya pelan.

sentences.en: No kindness is ever too small.
sentences.id: Tidak ada kebaikan yang terlalu kecil.

books.title: Hansel and Gretel
books.source: FIEZEL retelling of the Brothers Grimm tale (public domain).

about.en: A brother and sister are lost in a forest, and must think their way home.
about.id: Kakak beradik tersesat di hutan, dan harus berpikir untuk bisa pulang.

sentences.en: Hansel and Gretel lived near a great forest.
sentences.id: Hansel dan Gretel tinggal di dekat hutan besar.

sentences.en: Their family was very poor that year.
sentences.id: Keluarga mereka sangat miskin tahun itu.

sentences.en: There was almost no bread in the house.
sentences.id: Hampir tidak ada roti di rumah.

sentences.en: One night Hansel heard the adults talking.
sentences.id: Suatu malam Hansel mendengar orang dewasa berbicara.

sentences.en: They planned to leave the children in the forest.
sentences.id: Mereka berencana meninggalkan anak-anak di hutan.

sentences.en: Hansel did not cry.
sentences.id: Hansel tidak menangis.

sentences.en: He went outside and filled his pockets with small white stones.
sentences.id: Dia keluar dan mengisi sakunya dengan batu putih kecil.

sentences.en: In the morning the family walked deep into the forest.
sentences.id: Pagi harinya keluarga itu berjalan jauh ke dalam hutan.

sentences.en: Hansel dropped one stone every few steps.
sentences.id: Hansel menjatuhkan satu batu setiap beberapa langkah.

sentences.en: That night the moon made the stones shine like silver.
sentences.id: Malam itu bulan membuat batu-batu itu bersinar seperti perak.

sentences.en: The children followed them all the way home.
sentences.id: Anak-anak mengikutinya sampai ke rumah.

sentences.en: The second time, Hansel had no stones.
sentences.id: Kali kedua, Hansel tidak punya batu.

sentences.en: He used pieces of bread instead.
sentences.id: Dia memakai potongan roti sebagai gantinya.

sentences.en: But the birds ate every piece.
sentences.id: Tetapi burung-burung memakan semua potongan itu.

sentences.en: Now the children were truly lost.
sentences.id: Sekarang anak-anak itu benar-benar tersesat.

sentences.en: They walked for two days.
sentences.id: Mereka berjalan selama dua hari.

sentences.en: Then they saw a small house between the trees.
sentences.id: Lalu mereka melihat rumah kecil di antara pepohonan.

sentences.en: The walls were made of bread and cake.
sentences.id: Dindingnya terbuat dari roti dan kue.

sentences.en: The windows were made of clear sugar.
sentences.id: Jendelanya terbuat dari gula bening.

sentences.en: They were so hungry that they began to eat.
sentences.id: Mereka begitu lapar sampai mulai memakannya.

sentences.en: An old woman opened the door and smiled at them.
sentences.id: Seorang perempuan tua membuka pintu dan tersenyum kepada mereka.

sentences.en: The old woman was a witch.
sentences.id: Perempuan tua itu adalah penyihir.

sentences.en: She locked Hansel in a small room.
sentences.id: Dia mengurung Hansel di kamar kecil.

sentences.en: She made Gretel work in the kitchen.
sentences.id: Dia menyuruh Gretel bekerja di dapur.

sentences.en: Every day she asked Hansel to show his finger.
sentences.id: Setiap hari dia meminta Hansel menunjukkan jarinya.

sentences.en: She wanted to know if he was fat enough.
sentences.id: Dia ingin tahu apakah Hansel sudah cukup gemuk.

sentences.en: Hansel showed her a thin bone instead.
sentences.id: Hansel malah menunjukkan tulang yang kurus.

sentences.en: The witch had weak eyes and believed him.
sentences.id: Penyihir itu rabun dan mempercayainya.

sentences.en: One morning she asked Gretel to look inside the oven.
sentences.id: Suatu pagi dia menyuruh Gretel melihat ke dalam oven.

sentences.en: Gretel understood the trick.
sentences.id: Gretel mengerti tipuan itu.

sentences.en: "I do not know how," she said. "Please show me."
sentences.id: "Aku tidak tahu caranya," katanya. "Tolong tunjukkan."

sentences.en: The witch leaned in, and Gretel closed the door.
sentences.id: Penyihir itu mencondongkan badan, dan Gretel menutup pintunya.

sentences.en: She freed her brother at once.
sentences.id: Dia langsung membebaskan kakaknya.

sentences.en: They filled their pockets with the witch's treasure.
sentences.id: Mereka mengisi saku dengan harta penyihir itu.

sentences.en: A white duck carried them across the wide river.
sentences.id: Seekor bebek putih membawa mereka menyeberangi sungai lebar.

sentences.en: Their father cried when he saw them at the door.
sentences.id: Ayah mereka menangis saat melihat mereka di depan pintu.

sentences.en: They were never hungry again.
sentences.id: Mereka tidak pernah kelaparan lagi.

books.title: The Little Prince: An Extended Retelling
books.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry (1943)
books.source: An original extended FIEZEL retelling inspired by The Little Prince. The original text is still in copyright and is not reproduced verbatim. Indonesian translation is authored sentence by sentence.

about.en: A lonely pilot meets a young traveler from the stars and learns how attention, friendship, and responsibility give life its meaning.
about.id: Seorang pilot kesepian bertemu pengelana muda dari bintang dan memahami bahwa perhatian, persahabatan, serta tanggung jawab memberi makna pada kehidupan.

chapters.title: The Drawing Adults Could Not See

sentences.en: Long before he became a pilot, the narrator was a child who loved pictures and wild ideas.
sentences.id: Jauh sebelum menjadi pilot, sang narator adalah anak yang menyukai gambar dan gagasan liar.

sentences.en: A book about distant forests once showed him how patiently nature could hide danger.
sentences.id: Sebuah buku tentang hutan jauh pernah menunjukkan kepadanya bagaimana alam menyembunyikan bahaya dengan sabar.

sentences.en: Excited by what he had learned, he drew a giant snake resting after an enormous meal.
sentences.id: Karena bersemangat oleh pengetahuan barunya, dia menggambar ular raksasa yang beristirahat setelah makan besar.

sentences.en: The adults saw only the outside shape and mistook it for an ordinary piece of clothing.
sentences.id: Orang dewasa hanya melihat bentuk luarnya dan mengiranya sebagai pakaian biasa.

sentences.en: He tried again by drawing what was hidden inside, hoping the mystery would become clear.
sentences.id: Dia mencoba lagi dengan menggambar apa yang tersembunyi di dalamnya, berharap misterinya menjadi jelas.

sentences.en: Instead of becoming curious, the adults advised him to study practical subjects and abandon art.
sentences.id: Alih-alih penasaran, orang dewasa menyuruhnya mempelajari hal praktis dan meninggalkan seni.

sentences.en: Their certainty made him doubt the imagination that had once felt natural to him.
sentences.id: Keyakinan mereka membuatnya meragukan imajinasi yang dahulu terasa alami baginya.

sentences.en: He put away his pencils and eventually learned to guide airplanes across countries and oceans.
sentences.id: Dia menyimpan pensilnya dan akhirnya belajar menerbangkan pesawat melintasi negara serta samudra.

sentences.en: Flying taught him geography, weather, machines, and the quiet discipline of staying alive.
sentences.id: Penerbangan mengajarinya geografi, cuaca, mesin, dan disiplin sunyi untuk bertahan hidup.

sentences.en: Yet the people he met usually preferred numbers, status, and respectable conversation.
sentences.id: Namun orang-orang yang ditemuinya biasanya lebih menyukai angka, status, dan percakapan yang dianggap terhormat.

sentences.en: Sometimes he showed them his childhood picture to discover whether they could look beyond appearances.
sentences.id: Kadang dia menunjukkan gambar masa kecilnya untuk mengetahui apakah mereka mampu melihat melampaui penampilan.

sentences.en: When they failed the test, he hid his deeper thoughts and spoke the safe language of grown-ups.
sentences.id: Saat mereka gagal, dia menyembunyikan pikirannya yang lebih dalam dan memakai bahasa aman orang dewasa.

sentences.en: Years later, an engine failure forced the pilot to land in the vast Sahara Desert.
sentences.id: Bertahun-tahun kemudian, kerusakan mesin memaksa sang pilot mendarat di Gurun Sahara yang luas.

sentences.en: There was no mechanic, passenger, road, village, or radio nearby to rescue him.
sentences.id: Tidak ada mekanik, penumpang, jalan, desa, ataupun radio di dekatnya untuk menolongnya.

sentences.en: He carried only enough water for several days and knew every hour mattered.
sentences.id: Dia hanya membawa air untuk beberapa hari dan tahu bahwa setiap jam sangat berarti.

sentences.en: During daylight he studied the damaged engine and arranged his few tools in the sand.
sentences.id: Pada siang hari dia memeriksa mesin yang rusak dan menata sedikit perkakasnya di atas pasir.

sentences.en: At night the desert became cold, silent, and so wide that the stars seemed unusually near.
sentences.id: Pada malam hari gurun menjadi dingin, sunyi, dan begitu luas hingga bintang terasa sangat dekat.

sentences.en: He slept without shelter, surrounded by distances that no human voice could cross.
sentences.id: Dia tidur tanpa perlindungan, dikelilingi jarak yang tidak dapat ditembus suara manusia.

sentences.en: The practical adult in him counted water, repairs, and the chances of survival.
sentences.id: Sisi dewasa yang praktis dalam dirinya menghitung air, perbaikan, dan peluang untuk selamat.

sentences.en: The forgotten child in him watched the sky and felt the desert waiting for a secret.
sentences.id: Sisi anak-anak yang terlupakan dalam dirinya memandang langit dan merasa gurun sedang menunggu sebuah rahasia.

sentences.en: Before sunrise, a small and perfectly calm voice woke him from an exhausted sleep.
sentences.id: Menjelang matahari terbit, suara kecil yang sangat tenang membangunkannya dari tidur yang melelahkan.

sentences.en: The pilot first believed that heat, fear, or thirst had created the sound.
sentences.id: Awalnya sang pilot mengira panas, ketakutan, atau rasa haus telah menciptakan suara itu.

sentences.en: Then he opened his eyes and saw a golden-haired boy standing several steps away.
sentences.id: Kemudian dia membuka mata dan melihat anak berambut keemasan berdiri beberapa langkah darinya.

sentences.en: The stranger looked neither lost nor frightened, although no settlement existed for hundreds of miles.
sentences.id: Anak asing itu tampak tidak tersesat ataupun takut, meski tidak ada permukiman dalam jarak ratusan mil.

sentences.en: Without explaining who he was, the boy politely asked the pilot to sketch a young lamb.
sentences.id: Tanpa menjelaskan siapa dirinya, anak itu dengan sopan meminta sang pilot menggambar seekor domba muda.

sentences.en: The request was so unexpected that the broken airplane disappeared from the pilot's thoughts.
sentences.id: Permintaan itu begitu tidak terduga hingga pesawat rusak lenyap sejenak dari pikiran sang pilot.

sentences.en: He admitted that adults had ended his drawing career when he was still very young.
sentences.id: Dia mengakui bahwa orang dewasa telah mengakhiri karier menggambarnya ketika dia masih sangat muda.

sentences.en: The boy was not interested in excuses and simply repeated what he needed.
sentences.id: Anak itu tidak tertarik pada alasan dan hanya mengulangi apa yang dia perlukan.

sentences.en: The pilot drew several animals, but each one appeared too weak, too old, or quite wrong.
sentences.id: Sang pilot menggambar beberapa hewan, tetapi masing-masing tampak terlalu lemah, terlalu tua, atau tidak tepat.

sentences.en: Growing impatient, he finally drew a simple box and said the desired animal was resting inside.
sentences.id: Karena mulai tidak sabar, akhirnya dia menggambar kotak sederhana dan berkata hewan yang dimaksud beristirahat di dalamnya.

sentences.en: To his surprise, the boy's face brightened as if he had received exactly the right gift.
sentences.id: Yang mengejutkan, wajah anak itu berseri seolah dia telah menerima hadiah yang benar-benar tepat.

sentences.en: The unseen lamb could be healthy, gentle, and young because imagination supplied every missing detail.

sentences.en: At that lowest moment, another creature appeared and asked for neither praise nor ownership.
sentences.id: Pada saat terendah itu, makhluk lain muncul dan tidak meminta pujian ataupun kepemilikan.

sentences.en: The meeting would transform the boy's sadness into a deeper understanding of relationship.
sentences.id: Pertemuan itu akan mengubah kesedihan sang anak menjadi pemahaman yang lebih dalam tentang hubungan.

sentences.en: A fox greeted the boy from a distance but refused to become an instant playmate.
sentences.id: Seekor rubah menyapa sang anak dari kejauhan tetapi menolak langsung menjadi teman bermain.

sentences.en: He explained that friendship grows through repeated attention rather than sudden enthusiasm.
sentences.id: Dia menjelaskan bahwa persahabatan tumbuh melalui perhatian berulang dan bukan semangat sesaat.

sentences.en: At first they sat far apart, allowing silence to make their presence familiar.
sentences.id: Pada awalnya mereka duduk berjauhan, membiarkan kesunyian membuat kehadiran masing-masing terasa akrab.

sentences.en: Each day the boy returned at the same hour and moved a little closer.
sentences.id: Setiap hari sang anak kembali pada jam yang sama dan bergerak sedikit lebih dekat.

sentences.en: Because the time was expected, anticipation began to brighten the hours before their meeting.
sentences.id: Karena waktunya dapat diperkirakan, penantian mulai menerangi jam-jam sebelum pertemuan mereka.

sentences.en: Ordinary footsteps became meaningful because the fox learned to recognize one particular visitor.
sentences.id: Langkah kaki biasa menjadi bermakna karena sang rubah belajar mengenali seorang pengunjung tertentu.

sentences.en: Golden fields also changed, reminding him of the boy's hair whenever the wind moved the grain.
sentences.id: Ladang keemasan juga berubah, mengingatkannya pada rambut sang anak setiap kali angin menggerakkan gandum.

sentences.en: Their ritual did not make either of them property; it made each one irreplaceable to the other.
sentences.id: Ritual mereka tidak menjadikan siapa pun sebagai milik; ritual itu membuat mereka tak tergantikan satu sama lain.

sentences.en: When departure approached, the fox accepted that joy and grief often come from the same bond.
sentences.id: Ketika perpisahan mendekat, sang rubah menerima bahwa kegembiraan dan kesedihan sering lahir dari ikatan yang sama.

sentences.en: He taught the boy that time freely given to someone creates a responsibility that remains.
sentences.id: Dia mengajarkan bahwa waktu yang diberikan dengan sukarela kepada seseorang menciptakan tanggung jawab yang tetap tinggal.

sentences.en: The boy returned to the rose garden and understood why those flowers were not his flower.
sentences.id: Sang anak kembali ke taman mawar dan memahami mengapa bunga-bunga itu bukan bunganya.

sentences.en: His rose was unique because of shared mornings, arguments, protection, patience, and care.
sentences.id: Mawarnya unik karena pagi, pertengkaran, perlindungan, kesabaran, dan perhatian yang mereka jalani bersama.

sentences.en: Later the boy met a railway worker who directed crowded trains toward opposite horizons.
sentences.id: Kemudian sang anak bertemu petugas kereta yang mengarahkan kereta penuh penumpang menuju cakrawala berlawanan.

sentences.en: People rushed past windows, changed places, and often seemed unsure what they were seeking.
sentences.id: Orang-orang melintas cepat di balik jendela, berpindah tempat, dan sering tidak yakin apa yang mereka cari.

sentences.en: Only children pressed their faces to the glass and remained curious about the passing world.
sentences.id: Hanya anak-anak yang menempelkan wajah ke kaca dan tetap penasaran pada dunia yang berlalu.

sentences.en: The boy noticed that movement can look like purpose even when no destination satisfies anyone.
sentences.id: Sang anak menyadari bahwa pergerakan dapat tampak seperti tujuan meski tidak ada tujuan akhir yang memuaskan siapa pun.

sentences.en: He also met a merchant selling tablets that removed the physical feeling of thirst.
sentences.id: Dia juga bertemu pedagang yang menjual pil untuk menghilangkan rasa haus secara fisik.

sentences.en: The merchant proudly calculated how many minutes his product saved each week.
sentences.id: Pedagang itu dengan bangga menghitung berapa menit yang dihemat produknya setiap minggu.

sentences.en: The boy wondered why anyone would save time without knowing how to use it well.
sentences.id: Sang anak bertanya-tanya mengapa seseorang menghemat waktu tanpa mengetahui cara menggunakannya dengan baik.

sentences.en: Given an extra hour, he would rather walk slowly toward fresh water.
sentences.id: Jika mendapat satu jam tambahan, dia lebih memilih berjalan perlahan menuju air segar.

sentences.en: A real journey, he felt, includes waiting, effort, landscape, and the joy of arrival.
sentences.id: Menurutnya perjalanan sejati mencakup penantian, usaha, pemandangan, dan kegembiraan ketika tiba.

sentences.en: A shortcut may remove discomfort while also removing the experience that gives relief meaning.
sentences.id: Jalan pintas dapat menghilangkan ketidaknyamanan sekaligus pengalaman yang memberi makna pada kelegaan.

sentences.en: These meetings prepared him to return to the desert, where water could not be treated as a number.
sentences.id: Pertemuan-pertemuan itu mempersiapkannya kembali ke gurun, tempat air tidak dapat dianggap sekadar angka.

sentences.en: There, the pilot's failing supply would turn a simple drink into an unforgettable gift.
sentences.id: Di sana, persediaan sang pilot yang menipis akan mengubah minuman sederhana menjadi hadiah yang tak terlupakan.

sentences.en: Back beside the broken airplane, the pilot finally used the last of his drinking water.
sentences.id: Kembali di dekat pesawat rusak, sang pilot akhirnya menghabiskan air minumnya yang terakhir.

sentences.en: The engine still resisted repair, and the desert offered no visible path toward help.
sentences.id: Mesin masih sulit diperbaiki, dan gurun tidak menunjukkan jalan menuju pertolongan.

sentences.en: The boy listened calmly, then suggested that they search for a well.
sentences.id: Sang anak mendengarkan dengan tenang, lalu menyarankan agar mereka mencari sebuah sumur.

sentences.en: The idea appeared impossible because wells do not usually wait in empty sand without a village.
sentences.id: Gagasan itu tampak mustahil karena sumur biasanya tidak berada di pasir kosong tanpa desa.

sentences.en: Still, remaining beside the airplane promised only thirst, so they began walking after sunset.
sentences.id: Namun tetap berada di dekat pesawat hanya menjanjikan kehausan, sehingga mereka mulai berjalan setelah senja.

sentences.en: Moonlight softened the dunes, and the darkness made every small sound feel important.
sentences.id: Cahaya bulan melembutkan bukit pasir, dan kegelapan membuat setiap suara kecil terasa penting.

sentences.en: The boy said the desert was beautiful because it concealed something life-giving beneath its emptiness.
sentences.id: Sang anak berkata gurun itu indah karena menyembunyikan sesuatu yang memberi kehidupan di balik kekosongannya.

sentences.en: The pilot remembered an old house whose mystery came from stories of hidden treasure.
sentences.id: Sang pilot teringat rumah tua yang misterinya berasal dari kisah tentang harta tersembunyi.

sentences.en: He began to understand that visible surfaces often receive their meaning from what cannot be displayed.
sentences.id: Dia mulai memahami bahwa permukaan yang terlihat sering memperoleh makna dari sesuatu yang tidak dapat dipamerkan.

sentences.en: Near dawn, the boy became tired, and the pilot carried him across the cool sand.
sentences.id: Menjelang fajar, sang anak menjadi lelah dan sang pilot menggendongnya melintasi pasir yang sejuk.

sentences.en: Holding the sleeping traveler, he felt he was protecting a promise rather than merely a body.
sentences.id: Saat menggendong pengelana yang tertidur, dia merasa sedang melindungi sebuah janji dan bukan sekadar tubuh.

sentences.en: When morning arrived, they discovered an old well standing where logic said none should exist.
sentences.id: Ketika pagi tiba, mereka menemukan sumur tua berdiri di tempat yang menurut logika seharusnya tidak ada.

sentences.en: The well looked carefully built, with a bucket, rope, and pulley worn smooth by use.
sentences.id: Sumur itu dibangun dengan baik, memiliki ember, tali, dan katrol yang menjadi halus karena sering digunakan.

sentences.en: No houses surrounded it, yet everything seemed prepared for travelers who arrived in need.
sentences.id: Tidak ada rumah di sekitarnya, tetapi semuanya tampak disiapkan bagi pengelana yang datang dalam kebutuhan.

sentences.en: The boy pulled the rope, and the pulley answered with a long sound in the morning air.
sentences.id: Sang anak menarik tali, dan katrol menjawab dengan suara panjang di udara pagi.

sentences.en: The pilot finished lifting the heavy bucket and held it steady for his friend.
sentences.id: Sang pilot menyelesaikan tarikan ember yang berat dan memegangnya agar tetap stabil untuk temannya.

sentences.en: The water tasted precious because it contained walking, starlight, effort, trust, and shared hope.
sentences.id: Air itu terasa berharga karena mengandung perjalanan, cahaya bintang, usaha, kepercayaan, dan harapan bersama.

sentences.en: It was different from water taken thoughtlessly from a tap or swallowed while rushing elsewhere.
sentences.id: Air itu berbeda dari air yang diambil tanpa perhatian dari keran atau diminum sambil terburu-buru.

sentences.en: The pilot saw that value grows when attention connects ordinary things with a meaningful journey.
sentences.id: Sang pilot melihat bahwa nilai tumbuh ketika perhatian menghubungkan hal biasa dengan perjalanan yang bermakna.

sentences.en: The boy reminded him of the promised muzzle that would keep the lamb from harming the flower.
sentences.id: Sang anak mengingatkannya pada penutup mulut yang dijanjikan agar domba tidak menyakiti bunga.

sentences.en: Although the drawing was simple, the responsibility behind it had become serious.
sentences.id: Meskipun gambarnya sederhana, tanggung jawab di baliknya telah menjadi serius.

sentences.en: The boy then revealed that the next evening marked one year since his arrival on Earth.
sentences.id: Sang anak kemudian mengungkapkan bahwa malam berikutnya menandai satu tahun sejak kedatangannya di Bumi.

sentences.en: He planned to return to the exact place where his journey on the planet had begun.
sentences.id: Dia berencana kembali ke tempat yang tepat ketika perjalanannya di planet itu bermula.

sentences.en: The pilot sensed a hidden decision and felt fear enter a morning that had just brought relief.
sentences.id: Sang pilot merasakan keputusan tersembunyi dan merasa ketakutan memasuki pagi yang baru saja membawa kelegaan.

sentences.en: After returning to the airplane, the pilot worked urgently and finally restored the engine.
sentences.id: Setelah kembali ke pesawat, sang pilot bekerja dengan mendesak dan akhirnya berhasil memperbaiki mesin.

sentences.en: The success should have filled him with joy, but the boy had disappeared from the campsite.
sentences.id: Keberhasilan itu seharusnya membuatnya gembira, tetapi sang anak telah menghilang dari tempat perkemahan.

sentences.en: He found his friend near an old wall, speaking quietly to someone hidden below.
sentences.id: Dia menemukan temannya di dekat dinding tua, berbicara pelan kepada seseorang yang bersembunyi di bawah.

sentences.en: The snake's yellow body vanished among the stones before the pilot could reach it.
sentences.id: Tubuh kuning sang ular menghilang di antara batu sebelum sang pilot dapat mencapainya.

sentences.en: The boy looked pale, and his words confirmed that he intended to leave Earth that night.
sentences.id: Sang anak tampak pucat, dan kata-katanya menegaskan bahwa dia bermaksud meninggalkan Bumi malam itu.

sentences.en: He explained that his body was too heavy to carry across the distance between planets.
sentences.id: Dia menjelaskan bahwa tubuhnya terlalu berat untuk dibawa melintasi jarak antarplanet.

sentences.en: The pilot rejected every explanation because none could soften the thought of separation.
sentences.id: Sang pilot menolak setiap penjelasan karena tidak ada yang dapat melembutkan pikiran tentang perpisahan.

sentences.en: The boy tried to comfort him by describing the stars as places where laughter would continue.
sentences.id: Sang anak mencoba menghiburnya dengan menggambarkan bintang sebagai tempat tawa akan terus hidup.

sentences.en: For other people the night sky might remain silent, but shared memory would change it for the pilot.
sentences.id: Bagi orang lain langit malam mungkin tetap sunyi, tetapi kenangan bersama akan mengubahnya bagi sang pilot.

sentences.en: The pilot promised not to abandon him, even when the boy asked to face the final moment alone.
sentences.id: Sang pilot berjanji tidak meninggalkannya, meski sang anak meminta menghadapi saat terakhir sendirian.

sentences.en: Fear remained between them, but so did the trust built through questions, drawings, and water.
sentences.id: Ketakutan tetap berada di antara mereka, begitu pula kepercayaan yang dibangun melalui pertanyaan, gambar, dan air.

sentences.en: When darkness came, they walked together toward the place chosen for the boy's departure.
sentences.id: Ketika gelap tiba, mereka berjalan bersama menuju tempat yang dipilih untuk keberangkatan sang anak.

sentences.en: The desert night seemed motionless as the boy and the pilot reached the appointed place.
sentences.id: Malam gurun tampak tidak bergerak ketika sang anak dan sang pilot mencapai tempat yang telah ditentukan.

sentences.en: The boy worried that his friend would misunderstand what he was about to see.
sentences.id: Sang anak khawatir temannya akan salah memahami apa yang akan dilihatnya.

sentences.en: He compared the body to an empty covering that could be left behind without losing the traveler.
sentences.id: Dia membandingkan tubuh dengan pembungkus kosong yang dapat ditinggalkan tanpa kehilangan sang pengelana.

sentences.en: He spoke of his flower, admitting again that her weakness made his return necessary.
sentences.id: Dia berbicara tentang bunganya, kembali mengakui bahwa kelemahannya membuat kepulangannya diperlukan.

sentences.en: The thought of her alone beneath the stars was stronger than his fear of the snake.
sentences.id: Bayangan sang bunga sendirian di bawah bintang lebih kuat daripada ketakutannya kepada ular.

sentences.en: The pilot had no argument against a responsibility that had finally become clear to them both.
sentences.id: Sang pilot tidak memiliki bantahan terhadap tanggung jawab yang akhirnya menjadi jelas bagi mereka berdua.

sentences.en: A brief yellow movement appeared near the boy's ankle and disappeared almost immediately.
sentences.id: Gerakan kuning singkat muncul di dekat pergelangan kaki sang anak lalu menghilang hampir seketika.

sentences.en: He stood silently for a moment, as though listening to a call from very far away.
sentences.id: Dia berdiri diam sejenak, seolah mendengarkan panggilan dari tempat yang sangat jauh.

sentences.en: Then he fell gently onto the sand without struggle, accusation, or dramatic sound.
sentences.id: Kemudian dia jatuh perlahan ke atas pasir tanpa perlawanan, tuduhan, ataupun suara dramatis.

sentences.en: The pilot remained beside him, unable to decide whether the moment was an ending or a passage.
sentences.id: Sang pilot tetap berada di sampingnya, tidak mampu memutuskan apakah saat itu merupakan akhir atau perjalanan.

sentences.en: By morning the boy's body was gone, leaving no trail across the undisturbed desert.
sentences.id: Menjelang pagi tubuh sang anak telah tiada, tanpa meninggalkan jejak di gurun yang tidak terusik.

sentences.en: Because it had vanished, the pilot allowed hope to stand beside grief rather than replacing it.
sentences.id: Karena tubuh itu menghilang, sang pilot membiarkan harapan berdiri di samping kesedihan dan bukan menggantikannya.

sentences.en: The repaired airplane carried the pilot back to people who were relieved to see him alive.
sentences.id: Pesawat yang telah diperbaiki membawa sang pilot kembali kepada orang-orang yang lega melihatnya hidup.

sentences.en: He told them he was tired because the truth of his sorrow was too difficult to explain.
sentences.id: Dia mengatakan dirinya lelah karena kenyataan tentang kesedihannya terlalu sulit dijelaskan.

sentences.en: Years passed, and memory slowly changed from an open wound into a quiet companion.
sentences.id: Tahun-tahun berlalu, dan kenangan perlahan berubah dari luka terbuka menjadi teman yang tenang.

sentences.en: At night the stars no longer seemed like distant objects measured by astronomers.
sentences.id: Pada malam hari bintang tidak lagi tampak seperti benda jauh yang diukur para astronom.

sentences.en: They carried the possibility of laughter, a small planet, and a flower protected beneath glass.
sentences.id: Bintang membawa kemungkinan tawa, sebuah planet kecil, dan bunga yang dilindungi di bawah kaca.

sentences.en: Still, one mistake troubled the pilot whenever he thought about the lamb.
sentences.id: Namun satu kesalahan mengganggu sang pilot setiap kali dia memikirkan domba itu.

sentences.en: The muzzle he had drawn lacked a proper strap, so it might never have protected the rose.
sentences.id: Penutup mulut yang digambarnya tidak memiliki tali yang tepat, sehingga mungkin tidak pernah melindungi mawar.

sentences.en: Some nights he believed the boy guarded his flower carefully and everything remained well.
sentences.id: Pada beberapa malam dia percaya sang anak menjaga bunganya dengan hati-hati dan semuanya baik-baik saja.

sentences.en: On other nights he imagined one careless moment changing the whole meaning of the sky.
sentences.id: Pada malam lain dia membayangkan satu saat kelalaian mengubah seluruh makna langit.

sentences.en: The uncertainty mattered because love makes distant events important even when they cannot be verified.
sentences.id: Ketidakpastian itu penting karena kasih sayang membuat peristiwa jauh berarti meski tidak dapat dipastikan.

sentences.en: The pilot asked future travelers to watch the desert for a laughing boy with golden hair.
sentences.id: Sang pilot meminta pengelana masa depan memperhatikan gurun untuk mencari anak tertawa berambut keemasan.

sentences.en: His story leaves us with a choice: rush past the world, or care enough to make one part of it unique.
sentences.id: Kisahnya meninggalkan pilihan: bergegas melewati dunia, atau cukup peduli untuk membuat satu bagiannya menjadi unik.

books.title: Charlotte's Web
books.author: E. B. White (1952)
books.source: FIEZEL graded retelling. The original text is still in copyright and is not included.

about.en: A spider saves a pig's life with nothing but words.
about.id: Seekor laba-laba menyelamatkan nyawa seekor babi hanya dengan kata-kata.

sentences.en: A girl named Fern sees her father carrying an axe.
sentences.id: Seorang gadis bernama Fern melihat ayahnya membawa kapak.

sentences.en: One piglet was born very small and weak.
sentences.id: Salah satu anak babi lahir sangat kecil dan lemah.

sentences.en: On the farm, a weak piglet is usually not kept.
sentences.id: Di peternakan, anak babi yang lemah biasanya tidak dipelihara.

sentences.en: Fern begs her father to let the piglet live.
sentences.id: Fern memohon kepada ayahnya agar anak babi itu dibiarkan hidup.

sentences.en: She feeds him from a bottle and calls him Wilbur.
sentences.id: Dia memberinya susu dari botol dan menamainya Wilbur.

sentences.en: Later Wilbur is sold to her uncle's farm down the road.
sentences.id: Kemudian Wilbur dijual ke peternakan pamannya di ujung jalan.

sentences.en: In the barn, Wilbur is lonely and afraid.
sentences.id: Di kandang, Wilbur kesepian dan takut.

sentences.en: One night a quiet voice says hello from above.
sentences.id: Suatu malam sebuah suara pelan menyapa dari atas.

sentences.en: It is a grey spider named Charlotte.
sentences.id: Itu adalah laba-laba abu-abu bernama Charlotte.

sentences.en: She lives in a web near the door.
sentences.id: Dia tinggal di jaring dekat pintu.

sentences.en: An old sheep tells Wilbur the truth about winter.
sentences.id: Seekor domba tua memberi tahu Wilbur kebenaran tentang musim dingin.

sentences.en: Pigs on this farm do not usually live past Christmas.
sentences.id: Babi di peternakan ini biasanya tidak hidup sampai lewat Natal.

sentences.en: Wilbur begins to cry.
sentences.id: Wilbur mulai menangis.

sentences.en: "I will save you," Charlotte says.
sentences.id: "Aku akan menyelamatkanmu," kata Charlotte.

sentences.en: The next morning there are words in Charlotte's web.
sentences.id: Pagi berikutnya ada kata-kata di jaring Charlotte.

sentences.en: The words describe Wilbur, and the farmer reads them.
sentences.id: Kata-kata itu menggambarkan Wilbur, dan petani itu membacanya.

sentences.en: People come from far away to see the pig.
sentences.id: Orang-orang datang dari jauh untuk melihat babi itu.

sentences.en: Nobody thinks of eating a famous pig.
sentences.id: Tidak ada yang berpikir memakan babi yang terkenal.

sentences.en: Charlotte writes new words again and again.
sentences.id: Charlotte menulis kata-kata baru berulang kali.

sentences.en: At the county fair, Wilbur wins a special prize.
sentences.id: Di pekan raya, Wilbur memenangkan hadiah istimewa.

sentences.en: His life is safe now.
sentences.id: Nyawanya sekarang aman.

sentences.en: Charlotte is very tired after the fair.
sentences.id: Charlotte sangat lelah setelah pekan raya.

sentences.en: Spiders do not live long, and she knows it.
sentences.id: Laba-laba tidak hidup lama, dan dia tahu itu.

sentences.en: She makes one last thing: a small sac of eggs.
sentences.id: Dia membuat satu hal terakhir: kantung kecil berisi telur.

sentences.en: Wilbur carries the sac home carefully in his mouth.
sentences.id: Wilbur membawa kantung itu pulang dengan hati-hati di mulutnya.

sentences.en: Charlotte dies alone at the empty fairground.
sentences.id: Charlotte mati sendirian di arena pekan raya yang sudah sepi.

sentences.en: In spring, hundreds of baby spiders come out.
sentences.id: Pada musim semi, ratusan bayi laba-laba keluar.

sentences.en: Most fly away, but three of them stay with Wilbur.
sentences.id: Sebagian besar terbang pergi, tetapi tiga di antaranya tinggal bersama Wilbur.

sentences.en: A true friend can change a whole life.
sentences.id: Sahabat sejati bisa mengubah seluruh hidup seseorang.

books.title: The Giving Tree
books.author: Shel Silverstein (1964)
books.source: FIEZEL graded retelling. The original text is still in copyright and is not included.

about.en: A tree gives everything to a boy, across a whole lifetime.
about.id: Sebuah pohon memberikan segalanya kepada seorang anak, sepanjang hidupnya.

sentences.en: There was a tree, and she loved a little boy.
sentences.id: Ada sebuah pohon, dan dia menyayangi seorang anak kecil.

sentences.en: Every day the boy came to play.
sentences.id: Setiap hari anak itu datang bermain.

sentences.en: He climbed her trunk and swung from her branches.
sentences.id: Dia memanjat batangnya dan berayun di dahannya.

sentences.en: He ate her apples and slept in her shade.
sentences.id: Dia memakan apelnya dan tidur di bawah naungannya.

sentences.en: The boy loved the tree very much.
sentences.id: Anak itu sangat menyayangi pohon itu.

sentences.en: And the tree was happy.
sentences.id: Dan pohon itu bahagia.

sentences.en: Time passed, and the boy grew older.
sentences.id: Waktu berlalu, dan anak itu tumbuh besar.

sentences.en: He came back one day and said he wanted money.
sentences.id: Suatu hari dia kembali dan berkata dia ingin uang.

sentences.en: The tree gave him her apples to sell.
sentences.id: Pohon itu memberikan apel-apelnya untuk dijual.

sentences.en: Years later he came back and said he wanted a house.
sentences.id: Bertahun-tahun kemudian dia kembali dan berkata dia ingin rumah.

sentences.en: The tree gave him her branches.
sentences.id: Pohon itu memberikan dahan-dahannya.

sentences.en: Later he came back and said he wanted a boat.
sentences.id: Kemudian dia kembali dan berkata dia ingin perahu.

sentences.en: The tree gave him her trunk.
sentences.id: Pohon itu memberikan batangnya.

sentences.en: Each time, the tree was happy.
sentences.id: Setiap kali, pohon itu bahagia.

sentences.en: But each time, a little less.
sentences.id: Tetapi setiap kali, sedikit berkurang.

sentences.en: Many years later, the boy came back as an old man.
sentences.id: Bertahun-tahun kemudian, anak itu kembali sebagai orang tua.

sentences.en: The tree had nothing left to give.
sentences.id: Pohon itu tidak punya apa-apa lagi untuk diberikan.

sentences.en: "I am only an old stump now," she said.
sentences.id: "Sekarang aku hanya tunggul tua," katanya.

sentences.en: "I do not need much," the old man answered.
sentences.id: "Aku tidak butuh banyak," jawab orang tua itu.

sentences.en: "I am tired. I only want a quiet place to sit."
sentences.id: "Aku lelah. Aku hanya ingin tempat tenang untuk duduk."

sentences.en: So he sat down on the old stump.
sentences.id: Maka dia duduk di atas tunggul tua itu.

sentences.en: And the tree was happy.
sentences.id: Dan pohon itu bahagia.

sentences.en: Readers still argue about this ending.
sentences.id: Pembaca masih memperdebatkan akhir cerita ini.

sentences.en: Is it love, or is it something else?
sentences.id: Apakah ini cinta, atau sesuatu yang lain?

books.title: Matilda
books.author: Roald Dahl (1988)
books.source: FIEZEL graded retelling. The original text is still in copyright and is not included.

about.en: A brilliant girl with careless parents finds her own power in books.
about.id: Seorang gadis cerdas dengan orang tua yang acuh menemukan kekuatannya di dalam buku.

sentences.en: Matilda Wormwood learns to read when she is three years old.
sentences.id: Matilda Wormwood belajar membaca saat berumur tiga tahun.

sentences.en: Her parents watch television and think books are useless.
sentences.id: Orang tuanya menonton televisi dan menganggap buku tidak berguna.

sentences.en: Her father sells old cars and cheats his customers.
sentences.id: Ayahnya menjual mobil bekas dan menipu pelanggannya.

sentences.en: Nobody in the house notices how clever she is.
sentences.id: Tidak ada di rumah itu yang menyadari betapa cerdasnya dia.

sentences.en: So Matilda walks to the library alone.
sentences.id: Maka Matilda berjalan sendiri ke perpustakaan.

sentences.en: By the age of five she has read many grown-up books.
sentences.id: Pada usia lima tahun dia sudah membaca banyak buku orang dewasa.

sentences.en: When her father is cruel, she answers with small clever tricks.
sentences.id: Saat ayahnya kejam, dia membalas dengan tipuan-tipuan kecil yang cerdik.

sentences.en: At school, Matilda meets Miss Honey.
sentences.id: Di sekolah, Matilda bertemu Miss Honey.

sentences.en: Miss Honey is gentle, and she sees the truth at once.
sentences.id: Miss Honey lembut, dan dia langsung melihat kenyataannya.

sentences.en: This child is far ahead of the whole class.
sentences.id: Anak ini jauh melampaui seluruh kelas.

sentences.en: But the head teacher is Miss Trunchbull.
sentences.id: Tetapi kepala sekolahnya adalah Miss Trunchbull.

sentences.en: She is huge, loud and frightening.
sentences.id: Dia besar, keras, dan menakutkan.

sentences.en: She punishes children for almost nothing.
sentences.id: Dia menghukum anak-anak nyaris tanpa alasan.

sentences.en: Miss Honey asks her to move Matilda to a higher class.
sentences.id: Miss Honey memintanya memindahkan Matilda ke kelas yang lebih tinggi.

sentences.en: Miss Trunchbull refuses without listening.
sentences.id: Miss Trunchbull menolak tanpa mendengarkan.

sentences.en: One day, in a moment of anger, something strange happens.
sentences.id: Suatu hari, dalam kemarahan, sesuatu yang aneh terjadi.

sentences.en: Matilda moves a glass of water without touching it.
sentences.id: Matilda menggerakkan gelas air tanpa menyentuhnya.

sentences.en: She practises secretly until she can control it.
sentences.id: Dia berlatih diam-diam sampai bisa mengendalikannya.

sentences.en: Miss Honey tells Matilda about her own childhood.
sentences.id: Miss Honey menceritakan masa kecilnya sendiri kepada Matilda.

sentences.en: Her aunt took her house and her money, and that aunt is Miss Trunchbull.
sentences.id: Bibinya mengambil rumah dan uangnya, dan bibi itu adalah Miss Trunchbull.

sentences.en: Matilda decides to use her power for her teacher.
sentences.id: Matilda memutuskan memakai kekuatannya untuk gurunya.

sentences.en: In class, a piece of chalk begins to write by itself.
sentences.id: Di kelas, sebatang kapur mulai menulis sendiri.

sentences.en: It writes a message in the voice of Miss Honey's dead father.
sentences.id: Kapur itu menulis pesan dengan suara ayah Miss Honey yang telah meninggal.

sentences.en: It tells Miss Trunchbull to give everything back.
sentences.id: Pesan itu menyuruh Miss Trunchbull mengembalikan semuanya.

sentences.en: Miss Trunchbull is terrified and leaves for good.
sentences.id: Miss Trunchbull ketakutan dan pergi untuk selamanya.

sentences.en: Miss Honey gets her house and her life back.
sentences.id: Miss Honey mendapatkan kembali rumah dan hidupnya.

sentences.en: Matilda's parents must suddenly leave the country.
sentences.id: Orang tua Matilda tiba-tiba harus meninggalkan negara itu.

sentences.en: Matilda asks to stay with Miss Honey instead.
sentences.id: Matilda meminta untuk tinggal bersama Miss Honey.

sentences.en: Her parents agree without arguing, and drive away.
sentences.id: Orang tuanya setuju tanpa berdebat, lalu pergi.

sentences.en: For the first time, Matilda lives with someone who sees her.
sentences.id: Untuk pertama kalinya, Matilda tinggal bersama orang yang benar-benar melihatnya.
